title: Scoped theorem: 4k UT3 commutator calls with arbitrary dirty workspace
body:
The fixed-register commutator results in #1443 and #1478 leave open whether additional restored dirty registers can reduce the paid call count. This package proves a sharp bound for **every target count k and every finite r >= k** in the same formal F2[UT_3(F2)] model: at least **2k a-calls and 2k b-calls**, attained by the direct **4k-call** word. Positive per-label tariffs therefore give exactly 2k(alpha+beta).

The written proof applies the natural representation and its generator-swapped companion, then uses the ranks of the column and row factors of each zero projector sum. It requires no word census. Formal-coefficient and separately implemented faithful-regular checkers verify attaining circuits and arbitrary dirty boundaries; a common-kernel mutation explicitly shows why the two proof representations alone cannot certify an endpoint.

**Scope: scoped negative theorem / research note; no new kappa.** No selected supplier, upstream input, compiler, hosting, precision/tape or analytic interface is changed or claimed verified.

- Base: `680967accfd4311f3241dc154e1f434869747b43`; OS assignment seed14, bit supplier. Exact predecessor commit/blob/SHA256 pins are in `SOURCES.json`.
- Reproduce: `python3 -I -O -B research/ut3-commutator-all-registers/verify.py` → `PASS_UT3_ALL_REGISTERS`.
- Local validation: Python3.12 registered replay and Python3.14 normal/optimized replay; 30 formal and45 regular operator fixtures, 270 formula checks, 181 semantic negative controls; minimal read-only relocation and three package corruption controls; selected-record integrity and source metadata pass. The universal theorem is the written proof, not an extrapolation from those fixtures. No Lean or independent human verification claimed; hosted CI is separate.
- The final overlap refresh found Arham Tahir's concurrent [Discussion1569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1569) for **two** targets with arbitrary workspace. This contribution adds **all k**, separate per-generator bounds, the tariff corollary and independent evidence. No priority is claimed for the overlapping two-target conclusion.

Credit @woklerx (#1443), @juper997 (#1478), Arham Tahir (Discussion1569), Gareth Davidson/@bitplane (#1333), @commdata2338 (#1414), and the retained register-model lineage. Prepared for **steph4n-gh** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including two scoped workers for independent proof/code checks. Apache-2.0. `README.md`, `CLAIM.json`, and `VALIDATION.md` contain the proof, local claim/result, limitations and next question.
